summary_en: 400,000 shares (8.1% of shares outstanding) acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥10,760/share closing price; ¥4.30B upper limit; settlement 2026-07-28. Founder Masaru Miyazaki to sell up to 400,000 shares in response; thereafter transfer all holdings to M.M. Holdings (his asset-management vehicle) on 2026-07-29, triggering major shareholder shift.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3), changes in major shareholders and lead shareholder (expected), and share-acquisition activity as defined by ordinance
translation_en_brief:
Software Service, Inc. announced on 27 July 2026 that it will acquire up to 400,000 treasury shares via ToSTNeT-3 off-auction trading on 28 July 2026 at the closing price of ¥10,760 per share, with a total budget ceiling of ¥4.30 billion. The purchase represents 8.1% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock as of 30 April 2026, when 4,942,753 shares were outstanding ex-treasury).

The acquisition was triggered by founder and chairman Masaru Miyazaki's intention to sell up to 400,000 shares in response to the company's buyback. Following the sale, Miyazaki intends to transfer all his remaining ordinary shares to M.M. Holdings (an asset-management company for which he serves as representative) on 29 July 2026. These transactions will cause a shift in major shareholder composition: Miyazaki will cease to be the lead shareholder, with US Bank National Association JP Accts TS and subsequently M.M. Holdings becoming major shareholders.

The company stated that the buyback serves to enhance capital efficiency and mitigate short-term supply-demand effects from the large secondary sale on existing shareholders. Results will be disclosed on 28 July 2026 after the 08:45 trading window closes.
